indicator_name: Foreign-currency loans to total loans, deposit takers (IMF FSI)
description: Доля займов в иностранной валюте в совокупных займах депозитных организаций (МВФ FSI)
methodology: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (dataflow IMF.STA/FSIC), core indicators for deposit takers, reported by the Kazakh authorities (NBK, then ARDFM), quarterly. Foreign-currency loans to total loans, %, deposit takers, end of quarter -- a dollarisation measure for the credit side.
